detection.feedback_mechanism: Evidence records persisted; load_state_snapshot counts evidence >= 2; select_worker scales correlation utility.

correlation.feedback_mechanism: Correlation updates graph density; select_worker dampens correlation utility as graph approaches saturation.

investigation.feedback_mechanism: Investigation sets hypothesis status='confirmed'; load_state_snapshot detects confirmed hypothesis; select_worker surges response utility to 0.95.

response.feedback_mechanism: Response formulations mark has_formulated_response=True; response utility collapses to 0.05; reporting is prioritized for final dossier.

reporting.feedback_mechanism: Reporting generates 7-section report without replacing investigation or bypassing evidence grounding.
